title: membrane-propulsion: a synthetic Kuramoto-ring toy with an assumed-law probe and a passive sensor (not propulsion)
description: Synthetic, stdlib-only Python toy: a ring of 64 phase oscillators with a travelling drive, a probe whose velocity follows an assumed law (proportional to the local phase gradient), and a passive receiver sensor. It is not propulsion, not thrust, not a force or energy source and not a space drive; no physical claim is made. The repository documents measured behaviour and limits, including negative results (for example, the undriven ring drifts on its own in many seeds).
